subject: Upcoming Family Reunion Details
body: Dear Family Members, We are excited to announce that the upcoming family reunion will be held on Saturday, June 12th at Central Park. The event will start at 10:00 AM and include activities for all ages, delicious food, and a special surprise for everyone attending. Please RSVP by June 5th to confirm your attendance and let us know if you have any dietary restrictions. We can't wait to see you all and create lasting memories together! Best regards, The Family Reunion Committee
